	head.opts.EnableMemorySnapshotOnShutdown = true

	head, err = NewHead(nil, nil, w, nil, head.opts, nil)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.NoError(t, head.Init(math.MinInt64))

	_, _, _, err = LastChunkSnapshot(head.opts.ChunkDirRoot)
	require.Equal(t, record.ErrNotFound, err)

	require.NoError(t, head.Close())

part.text:
Fixed in tsdb/head_wal.go:1409 — `loadChunkSnapshot` now compares the snapshot's recorded WAL segment index against the current WAL's last segment (`wlog.Segments`). If the snapshot is ahead of the WAL (i.e., the WAL was reset after the snapshot was taken, which is why the stale Aug snapshot survived `DeleteChunkSnapshots` and kept winning the max-index comparison), the stale snapshots are deleted and startup falls back to full WAL replay instead of loading them.

Verified: `TestSnapshotAheadOfWALError` (the new regression test) plus the other chunk-snapshot tests pass, and the entire `tsdb` package passes (`go test ./tsdb -count=1`). Only tsdb/head_wal.go was modified; no test files touched.
